Author: Marius Emyr (MusicManBowls), based on Brio by Minmoose, Asgard and Contributors
Name: Marionette
Description:
Pose, stage and film your characters in GPose by grabbing them with the mouse.
- Drag any body part, with limbs that follow naturally; double click a hand or the head for fingers and the face
- Add people, NPCs and creatures to the scene, from your saved Glamourer designs or the game
- Emotes, walks, runs and expressions, with a free camera that flies anywhere
- Photos with bars, looks and background blur, shown live on the game
- The Director: make your own cutscenes with shots, camera paths, talk boxes, voices, music and sound effects
- Record them to MP4, frame perfect or live, with each kind of sound as its own track if you like

Marionette is a modified version of Brio, and like Brio it is licensed under the GPL 3.0. Turn Brio off while using it.
Punchline: Pose, stage and film your characters in GPose, puppeteer style.
